capabilities: Generate report or summary notes from YouTube, Reddit, X/Twitter, and PDF URLs
Generate standalone research reports from direct questions
Find and link related notes using keyword overlap or semantic snapshots
Fetch YouTube transcripts and optionally strip timestamps and audio cues
Write generated notes to a configurable output folder
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires a DeepSeek API key; X/Twitter source additionally needs a bearer token.
problem: Manually summarizing external sources like videos, posts, and PDFs into notes and finding where they connect to existing ideas is slow and manual.
summary: AI plugin that turns YouTube videos, web pages, PDFs, and questions into structured notes and links them to related notes in the vault.
